topic: The Central Limit Theorem (CLT): The Bridge to Normalcy

sections.title: The Hook: The Chaos of Individuality
lecture_lines: Individual data points are often wildly chaotic.
Different distributions show unique, messy patterns.
We calculate sample means to find stability.
animations: Create 500 scattered dots (#FF5733) representing chaotic individual data using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg].
Display text 'Data Points' (#FFFFFF) near the scattered dots.
Animate dots drifting randomly across the black screen.

sections.title: The Experiment: From Chaos to Order
lecture_lines: Take multiple random samples from a population.
Calculate the mean for each group.
Plot these means on a new graph.
animations: Create a central vertical axis (#FFFFFF) labeled 'Mean' using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/graph.svg].
Animate [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/dots.svg] moving toward the vertical axis over time.

sections.title: The Big Reveal: The Normal Distribution
lecture_lines: Populations can be any random shape.
Sample means form a normal distribution.
The bell curve stabilizes with larger samples.
The center matches the population mean.
It's the CLT bridging chaos to order.

Fade out individual dots leaving only the bell curve.

sections.title: Key Conditions for Validity
lecture_lines: Samples must be independent and random.
Use a sample size of thirty or more.
These conditions guarantee a normal curve.
animations: Display text 'Independent Trials' (#00FF00) on the screen alongside the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/dice.svg].
Display text 'Large Sample Size' (#00FF00) below the first text alongside the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ruler.svg].
Show checkmarks (#FFFF00) appearing next to both conditions.

sections.title: The 'Why It Matters' Application
lecture_lines: CLT lets us infer population properties.
We predict vast outcomes from small samples.
This saves time, effort, and resources.
